serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: The Manhattan Government Cloud provides US government agencies and customers supporting the US government a secure and reliable enterprise supply chain and logistics system. This system supports a comprehensive set of logistics functions: purchasing, ordering, replenishment, fulfillment, supplier integration, inventory management, overall supply chain visibility, warehouse management, asset tracking, transportation procurement, transportation planning, transportation execution, delivery, and acceptance. This highly configurable SaaS solution supports government missions such as disaster relief, humanitarian aid, homeland security, warfighter support, food supply, government IT, and supply chain security. Manhattan Government Cloud currently offers the following Manhattan Associates products: Warehouse Management, Transportation Planning & Execution, Transportation Procurement, Supply Chain Visibility, Supply Chain Event Management, Supplier Enablement, Hub Management, Operational Supply Chain Intelligence, Distributed Order Management, and Manhattan Integration Framework.
